question: to the Commission Anja Arndt (ESN) Subject:

Does the Commission have any information as to whether any Member States are currently carrying out, or have in the past carried out, programmes for actively influencing the weather – for example, for altering precipitation (so-called cloud seeding)?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (3.6.2026) Weather modification, most notably through cloud seeding to reduce the risk/impact of hail damage or to locally alter precipitation, has been widely practiced in many countries, including in Member States, for decades. The Commission has not been monitoring cloud-seeding programs or activities in a systematic manner and has no comprehensive information on their current state of implementation in the Member States, or their extent.
